summary.intent: Merge origin/main into the phase-44 branch (feat/ipns-conflict-handling), ship the work as PR #488, and resolve all CI failures and review comments to get the PR merged.
summary.outcome: PR #488 was created, all CI checks passed after fixing a stale test assertion and malformed commit message scopes, 2 CodeRabbit threads were resolved, and the PR was merged to main (52 files, +6360/-201 lines).

repo: Web vitest only runs *.test.ts files — *.spec.ts files in apps/web are silently skipped by the test runner, making them dead code. apps/api (NestJS/jest) legitimately uses .spec.ts convention.
The Release Preview CI job enforces conventional-commit messages on every commit touching a versioned package; it exits 1 on violations and is a required-to-merge check.
The `release:none` label escape hatch cancels ALL version bumps for the PR — wrong for real features; fixing commit messages is the correct path.

Repo is squash-merge only (PR_TITLE as the squash subject), so the conventional-commit PR title is what lands on main, not the individual commit messages — but the Release Preview job still validates those commit messages on the PR branch.
GSD ship workflow's literal 'Phase N: name' PR title format is rejected by pr-title.yml CI; must use a conventional-commit format instead.
required_signatures is false, so filter-branch message-only rewrites without re-signing are allowed.
The Release Preview bot pushes a `chore(release): set release targets for PR #N` commit to the branch after PR creation — must fetch before any subsequent pushes to avoid non-fast-forward errors.
gsd commit helper has a known false-negative: reports `commit_failed` but the commit actually lands; verify with git log.
Phase-44 code lives entirely in packages/sdk-core/, packages/sdk/, and apps/web/src/hooks/ — zero overlap with apps/api/, apps/desktop/, or crates/.
The packages/sdk test suite was not run during phase-44 local verification (only sdk-core was), which allowed a stale test to slip through to CI.
1Password SSH signing requires unsandboxed Bash; sandboxed commands hang waiting for the Touch ID prompt.

code.finding: fetchQuota() is fire-and-forget with .then() only — no .catch(), so a rejection is silently swallowed and never reaches logger.warn. The warn only fires on resolved-falsy (one argument), not on rejection.

params.fileIpnsPrivateKey.fill(0) zeroizes the key buffer in-place after use. Any test that shares a mockPrivateKey across test cases at describe scope will see an all-zero key after the first invocation.
mockPrivateKey was declared once at describe scope; after the first test ran updateFileMetadata it was zeroed. Fixed by moving to let + reinit in beforeEach.

Comment explicitly states: updateFileMetadata now publishes internally with CAS; the separate batchPublishIpnsRecords call was removed from updateSharedFile to avoid double-publish. The shared-write.test.ts assertion for batchPublishIpnsRecords was stale.

workflow: When a long-running branch carries its own sequential implementation of phases that were later merged separately via their own PRs, all conflicts on the already-merged phases should take origin/main's versions (the PR-reviewed canonical ones). Verify zero overlap with the branch's unique phase before applying wholesale.
Before resolving conflicts wholesale with 'theirs', map each conflicted file to its branch commits to confirm the current branch's unique work has zero overlap with the conflicting files.
Use `git filter-branch --msg-filter` for message-only rewrites; verify afterward with `git diff <old-tip>` to confirm the tree is byte-identical (empty diff = message-only).
Force-push with --force-with-lease after history rewrites, not --force, to guard against concurrent bot pushes.

When a PR branch has 100+ commits but the net diff is small, check `git diff base...HEAD` (three dots) to confirm the actual PR surface area — cosmetic history from a long branch collapses on squash-merge.
Delegating slow/verbose build checks (pnpm typecheck, cargo check) to sub-agents keeps the main context window clean and avoids token bloat from build output.
Post PR review replies via REST (--field not -f for in_reply_to integer), resolve threads via GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread.
When deleting a stale duplicate test file, prefer deletion over patching the broken assertions — deleting removes the confusion permanently and loses no real coverage if the canonical version exists.

friction: Transient git index.lock collision hit two files (commands/sync.rs, fuse/mod.rs) during batch conflict resolution — likely caused by a background file watcher; had to retry those two files after the lock cleared.

Two commits from early phase-44 work used 'feat 44-02:' and 'test 44-02:' (space instead of parentheses for scope), blocking the required Release Preview CI check and requiring a filter-branch history rewrite after PR creation.
packages/sdk tests were not included in phase-44 local verification, so a stale batchPublishIpnsRecords assertion in shared-write.test.ts only surfaced in CI after the PR was created.
The gsd commit helper false-negative (reporting commit_failed when the commit succeeded) requires a redundant git log verification step after every gsd commit invocation.
git filter-repo is not installed; had to use the deprecated git filter-branch instead.

The GSD ship workflow's PR title template ('Phase N: name') conflicts with the repo's conventional-commit CI enforcement — required deviation from the workflow spec to avoid a CI failure on a required check.
delete.service.spec.ts was a stale branch-phase-42 duplicate that survived the merge because the filenames differed (no conflict), only surfacing as a CodeRabbit finding post-PR.
